movingTips.title: International moving tips
movingTips.subtitle: Everything you need to know for a successful, smooth international move

tips.title: Start planning early
tips.content: Begin planning your move at least 8 weeks before the scheduled date. This gives you time to get better quotes and prepare properly.

tips.title: Pack professionally
tips.content: Use quality packing materials. Wrap fragile items in bubble wrap and fill empty spaces with cardboard or packing paper.

tips.title: Inventory and documents
tips.content: Prepare a detailed inventory of all items, photograph valuables for insurance, and keep copies of important documents.

tips.title: Comprehensive insurance
tips.content: Invest in comprehensive shipping insurance. It covers damage or loss of high-value items during the move.

tips.title: Research your new country
tips.content: Learn about customs rules, climate, and local culture. This helps you prepare better for your new life.

tips.title: Label boxes clearly
tips.content: Write the contents and destination room on every box. Use different colors for different rooms.

tips.title: Keep important documents with you
tips.content: Passport, visa, medical and financial documents — keep them in a separate bag that travels with you, not in the shipment.

tips.title: Plan your first days
tips.content: Prepare a plan for the first days in your new place: lodging, basic food, and transportation.

accessibilityStatement.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibilityStatement.subtitle: VIP International Shipping is Committed to Digital Accessibility
accessibilityStatement.badgesNote: These badges describe our accessibility goals and ongoing work. They are not a claim of completed third-party certification or a VPAT.
accessibilityStatement.commitmentBody: VIP International Shipping is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. We are continually improving the user experience for everyone and applying the relevant accessibility standards.
accessibilityStatement.goalsIntro: We are actively improving toward the following accessibility standards. This page describes our program and goals; it does not assert completed formal certification:

goals.title: WCAG 2.1 Level AA (target)
goals.body: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 at the AA level. These guidelines explain how to make web content more accessible for people with disabilities, and user friendly for everyone.

goals.title: ADA Title III (program)
goals.body: Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) Title III requirements for public accommodations and commercial facilities, ensuring equal access to our services.

goals.title: Section 508 (alignment goal)
goals.body: Section 508 of the Rehabilitation Act, requiring federal agencies and contractors to make their electronic and information technology accessible to people with disabilities.

goals.title: EN 301 549 (alignment goal)
goals.body: European Standard for digital accessibility, ensuring compatibility with international requirements.

accessibilityStatement.goalsStatus: Program status: We are actively working toward WCAG 2.1 Level AA. Improvements are ongoing; this is not a claim of completed third-party certification.

featureGroups.title: Keyboard Navigation
items: Full keyboard accessibility throughout the site
Skip navigation links for quick access to main content
Logical tab order for all interactive elements
Visible focus indicators on all focusable elements
No keyboard traps

featureGroups.title: Visual Accessibility
items: High contrast ratios (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text)
Resizable text up to 200% without loss of functionality
Alternative text for all meaningful images
Clear visual hierarchy and consistent navigation
No information conveyed by color alone
Support for browser zoom and text-only zoom

featureGroups.title: Screen Reader Compatibility
items: Semantic HTML markup for proper structure
ARIA labels and landmarks where appropriate
Descriptive link text and button labels
Table headers properly associated with data cells
Form labels correctly associated with inputs
Status messages announced to assistive technology

featureGroups.title: Content Accessibility
items: Clear and simple language
Consistent page layouts and navigation
Headings used to organize content hierarchically
Lists used for grouping related items
Sufficient time limits with options to extend
No automatically playing audio or video

featureGroups.title: Mobile and Touch Accessibility
items: Responsive design for all device sizes
Touch targets at least 44x44 pixels
Adequate spacing between interactive elements
Orientation flexibility (portrait and landscape)
Gesture alternatives for all interactions

featureGroups.title: Forms and Interactions
items: Clear error messages and validation
Error prevention and confirmation for critical actions
Inline help and instructions
Autocomplete attributes for common fields
Multiple ways to submit forms

accessibilityStatement.feedbackBody: We welcome your feedback on the accessibility of VIP International Shipping's website. Please let us know if you encounter accessibility barriers:
accessibilityStatement.responseTime: We aim to respond to accessibility feedback within 2 business days.
limitations: Third-Party Content: Some embedded content from third-party providers (e.g., payment processors, social media widgets) may not be fully accessible. We are working with these providers to improve accessibility.
PDF Documents: Some older PDF documents may not be fully accessible. We are in the process of remediating these documents and providing accessible alternatives.

Complex Interactive Features: Some advanced interactive features (e.g., 3D volume calculators, augmented reality tools) may have limited accessibility. We provide alternative methods to access the same functionality.
Legacy Content: Older blog posts and archived content are being updated to meet current accessibility standards.
accessibilityStatement.limitationsNote: Alternative Access: If you encounter any accessibility barriers, please contact us. We will provide alternative methods to access the information or service you need.
ongoing: Regularly reviewing and updating our accessibility policies and practices
Providing accessibility training for all staff members
Including accessibility in our design and development process from the start
Conducting regular accessibility audits and user testing
Prioritizing accessibility in our product roadmap
Engaging with the disability community for feedback and guidance
Staying current with evolving accessibility standards and best practices
accessibilityStatement.ongoingNote: Audit status: No formal third-party accessibility audit or VPAT has been completed yet. We are working toward WCAG 2.1 AA and will update this page after an independent review.
accessibilityStatement.contactTitle: Accessibility is a Right, Not a Feature
accessibilityStatement.contactBody: We believe that everyone deserves equal access to our services, regardless of ability. This commitment extends beyond legal compliance—it's about creating an inclusive experience for all users. Thank you for helping us improve accessibility by sharing your feedback.

whyTrust.title: Why Trust VIP International Shipping?
whyTrust.intro1: An international move is a significant milestone in life, whether you're expanding your business, reconnecting with loved ones, retiring in a more affordable destination, or finding a place with the ideal climate.
whyTrust.intro2: At VIP International Shipping, we specialize in international relocation, offering a reliable and global network to make your move smooth and hassle-free. We are dedicated to ensuring the safe and timely transportation of your belongings, no matter where your new journey takes you.
whyTrust.intro3: With a strong presence in key locations around the world, including exclusive partnerships across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia, VIP International Shipping is equipped to handle all aspects of your move. Our team ensures personalized services to meet the unique needs of each client.

sections.title: Global Coverage
sections.body: VIP International Shipping offers seamless service across all continents, with dedicated teams on both the East and West coasts of the United States. We ensure your move is taken care of no matter where it’s heading.

sections.title: Storage and Preparation
sections.body: Our state-of-the-art facilities in the US and Europe allow us to store and prepare shipments efficiently. Your items will be carefully handled, ensuring their safety during transit.

sections.title: Licensed and Trusted
sections.body: VIP International Shipping is fully licensed by the Federal Maritime Commission for international sea shipments. You can trust us with your most valuable possessions for a smooth and secure move.

sections.title: Household and Office Relocations
sections.body: Whether you’re moving your household, office, or specialized items like vehicles or artwork, VIP International Shipping is equipped to handle all aspects of your move with personalized service.

sections.title: Reliable and Stress-Free Service
sections.body: We ensure your move is stress-free by providing reliable and timely transportation of your belongings, whether it’s across the country or around the world.
